player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I returned to the starting room (Nursery) and immediately declared "DONE" without checking if other rooms remained unvisited. My strategy lacked a mechanism to track visited locations. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms. Upon returning to the Nursery, instead of stopping, I will check the available directions (south) and only proceed if that direction leads to a room not yet on my visited list. I will continue exploring until the set of visited rooms equals the total number of unique rooms encountered, ensuring no unvisited areas are left behind before issuing "DONE".
